summary: UI animation with Motion (motion.dev, formerly Framer Motion): springs, gestures, enter and exit, layout transitions and scroll effects that respect reduced motion.
whenToUse: The project depends on motion or framer-motion and a component needs animation, transitions or gesture feedback.
whenNotToUse: The project uses another animation library such as GSAP or Anime.js; use that library's skill instead.
verification: Every animation still works with reduced motion on.
Exit animations run inside AnimatePresence with stable keys.
